question: I failed my exams and I feel like there is no point going on. What should I do?

- Do not spend the whole night before the examination cramming; go to bed early so you feel refreshed the next morning [S2].
- Consider working with a study partner or group, working with others who made the study commitment, discussing with students in your classes or a senior in the hall of residence, and working out a mutual timetable [S6].

- If you fail three subjects of the First or Second Professional Examination, you shall be required to repeat the year (subject to 18.16 (a)) [S1].
